tidbit: Did you know… about 15,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
The Department of Homeland Security has ordered federal civilian agencies to stop using and remove DeepSeek artificial intelligence products, including third-party services that rely on DeepSeek models. Confirmed by gHacks: the government is taking action to protect sensitive data.
An ex-OpenAI worker accused of planting a device received support from Saudi Arabia, according to a court filing. Reported by BBC: the allegations reveal international involvement in the case.
The United States has banned DeepSeek artificial intelligence from civilian government systems over data security risks and concerns about the transfer of sensitive data to China. Confirmed by Mint: the government is moving to safeguard federal information.
Free every hour.
